auth.heroDescription: Your companies, your people, and your next opportunity. Together in one workspace.
auth.tagline: Bubllio CRM · Built to be yours
auth.accessHelp: Use your existing Bubllio account. Need access? Contact your workspace owner.

organizations.title: Your workspaces
organizations.description: A home for every team and every relationship.
organizations.emptyDescription: You will see a workspace here after an administrator invites you.
organizations.awaitingDescription: These workspaces are not accessible until the nominated owner accepts the invitation.
organizations.name: Workspace name
organizations.ownerEmail: Business owner email (use your own email to own it yourself)
organizations.cancelDescription: This deletes the pending workspace and invalidates its owner invitation. You cannot undo this action.

descriptions.admin: Secure your installation with its first administrator.
descriptions.workspace: Give your team a place to work together.
descriptions.email: Connect email now, or leave it for later.
descriptions.review: Check everything before creating your workspace.

setup.heroDescription: A few focused steps to make Bubllio yours. Nothing is created until you confirm the final review.
setup.privacy: Private setup · Your data stays in your installation
setup.tokenNotice: Copy the one-time token from the server's BUBLLIO_SETUP_TOKEN setting. It stays in memory only while this page is open.
setup.setupTokenHelp: The one-time token configured on your server; not your admin password.
setup.adminUsernameHelp: Use this to sign in to Bubllio and Django admin.
setup.adminEmailHelp: Email address for the first administrator account.
setup.adminPasswordHelp: Choose a strong password of at least 8 characters.
setup.workspaceNameHelp: The name your team will see in the app, for example Nerds Lab.
setup.workspaceSlugHelp: A short lowercase identifier, for example nerds-lab.
setup.ownerNotice: The admin account from the previous step becomes this workspace's owner.
setup.smtpOptional: This step is optional. You can add an email account later from account or workspace settings.
setup.encryptionNotice: Set BUBLLIO_EMAIL_ENCRYPTION_KEYS on the server before finishing setup. The test below sends a real email.
setup.accountLabelHelp: A name for this SMTP account, for example Primary.
setup.senderEmailHelp: The address recipients will see as the sender.
setup.smtpHostHelp: Provided by your email service, for example smtp.example.com.
setup.smtpUsernameHelp: The username supplied by your email provider.
setup.smtpPasswordHelp: Often an app password, not your personal email password.
setup.ssl: Use SSL on port 465 (unchecked: STARTTLS on port 587)
setup.testDescription: We'll send one message using the SMTP details above. Nothing is saved until you finish setup.
setup.testRecipientHelp: Use an inbox you can check now to confirm delivery.
setup.testFailed: Could not send the test email. Check the SMTP settings and recipient, then try again.
setup.testAccepted: The SMTP server accepted a test email. Check the recipient inbox to confirm delivery.
setup.testMissing: No successful test email yet. You can go back to test it or finish setup and troubleshoot later.
setup.completionNotice: Completing setup creates the admin account and workspace. You will sign in afterward.

passwordReset.requestSuccess: If an account exists for that email, reset instructions have been sent.
passwordReset.requestFailed: Could not request a password reset.
passwordReset.resetSuccess: Password reset successfully. You can now sign in.
passwordReset.newDescription: Use a strong password you have not used before.
passwordReset.requestDescription: Enter your account email and we will send reset instructions.
